description: Populate an ArrayList<String> with add(), read elements by index with get() and size(), remove the middle element, and traverse with an enhanced for loop.

steps.description: Import ArrayList, construct ArrayList<String> arr, and loop i from 0 to 9 calling arr.add(x) to append 'Test #0' through 'Test #9'.
Use a standard indexed for loop up to arr.size() and call arr.get(i) to print each element in order.

steps.answer: Since arr.size() is 10, arr.remove(5) removes 'Test #5' at index 5 and shifts 'Test #6' through 'Test #9' down by one index so arr.size() becomes 9.
steps.question: Which string does arr.remove(arr.size() / 2) remove, and what happens to the elements after it?

steps.description: Remove the element at index arr.size() / 2 and iterate over the remaining 9 elements with the enhanced for loop for(String item: arr).
Inspect arr right after arr.remove(arr.size() / 2) to see 'Test #5' removed and the remaining elements shifted down.

title: Adding, Accessing, and Removing Elements in an ArrayList
